fixed.summary: Clouds retain the spectrum of sky fill instead of becoming greyer with coverage, and physical skies derive underside fill from their own atmosphere. Low-sun shadows follow the sun down to 2.9 degrees. Diffuse sunlight is normalized as reflected irradiance and no longer inherits fine near-shadow marbling; directional scattering still supplies self-shadow and lit rims.

Cloud erosion uses broader billows, filters fine detail towards its mean at the pixel footprint and cloud top, and blends anvil-cap erosion with its dimensional envelope. Authored coverage, density, layer depth and shadow strength are unchanged.
